overview: Give us a list of what you want changed or fixed in your PrestaShop theme. We edit the template files, styles and theme options on a duplicate of your store so nothing breaks while we work. Typical jobs include a header redesign, a product page layout change, a mobile menu bug, a new home section or a restyled checkout. You get a preview and a list of the files we touched before it goes live.

faq: Will you edit my live store directly?
No. We work on a duplicate store and show you a preview. When you approve, we apply the changes to your live store or give you the files, as you prefer.
Does it matter which theme I use?
We work with Classic, Hummingbird and many third party themes. If a theme is heavily encrypted or locked, we tell you before we start what is possible.
Can you fix a theme broken by an update?
Yes. We find the template or module override that no longer fits the new version, repair it and check the main pages again.
What do you need from me?
Back office access or a copy of the theme files, a list of changes with screenshots, and a link to any page that looks wrong. We never ask for your password.
